The New Racial Regime by Alana Lentin
The New Racial Regime: Recalibrations of White Supremacy
by Alana Lentin
Pluto Press, 2025, 304 pages, $45.95
Alana Lentin, Professor of Cultural and Social Analysis at Western Sydney University, has deservedly acquired a reputation—in a competitive field, mind you—as one of the nation’s leading race-mongers. In 2017, in a piece of moral idiocy on ABC Radio’s The Minefield program titled—the question mark was superfluous—“Wrong to be White?”, Lentin flung her academic inanities at a wide listenership and a receptive panel, as she banged on about “the irredeemable nature of whiteness” and other soon-to-be-hot topics in Critical Race Theory (CRT).
By 2020, as the post-George Floyd racial panic and the Black Lives Matter swindle swept the world, Lentin boasted the correct credentials and vocabulary to become Australia’s go-to academic windbag on CRT’s takeover of the corporate, media and education spheres. Her timely—though not exactly…
